strings.59-ФЗ статья 11 Ответы были, но у другог: 59-FZ Article 11 There were responses, but from another authority
strings.59-ФЗ, статья 12, часть 1: рассмотрение: Federal Law No. 59-FZ, Article 12, part 1: reviewing a submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.Адресаты и предмет прежних писем: Recipients and subjects of earlier letters
strings.Были ли обращения раньше в наш орган?: Have you appealed to our authority before?
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В этой смене вы готовите проект решения: In this shift, you prepare a draft decision for the authorized head and organizational steps for the specified body. You do not order inspections or penalties on behalf of another agency. No real messages are sent.
strings.Все органы составляют единую приёмную, п: All authorities form one reception office, so the author of the earlier response does not matter.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
All that matters is any number in the database.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Да, они помогают увидеть, что уже разъяс: Yes, they show what has already been explained and what remains unresolved.
strings.Закрыть первое обращение в наш орган как: Close the first appeal to our authority because of repeated correspondence with others.
strings.Их можно использовать как материалы, не: They may be used as materials without treating others’ correspondence as our own.
strings.Какое различие адресатов здесь существен: Which difference between recipients matters here?
Which difference between recipients matters here? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Конкретный предмет указан в полномочиях: The specific subject is within the current authority’s powers. Earlier responses are attached for comparison. A letter on a familiar topic must not automatically be labelled repeated correspondence with this authority.
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения обращения: Last day for reviewing the submission
strings.Мне уже отвечали две организации. Сейчас: Two organisations have already replied to me. I came to your authority now because the earlier letters involve different powers. Here they say there will be no new response because correspondence on this topic already exists.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью о порядке рассмотрения от: Find the article on handling specific types of appeals and match the relevant part to the case circumstances.
Our authority must assess its own subject.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Не прекращать собственное рассмотрение н: Do not end our own consideration on the basis of someone else’s correspondence; assess the established issue within our remit.

Do not end your own review on the basis of another authority's correspondence; assess the established issue within your competence. Checking new arguments is not enough: this variant changes which body gave the previous responses. A first appeal to the competent authority cannot be closed on the basis of other authorities' history.
strings.Нужно установить субъекта прежнего рассм: Identify who carried out the earlier consideration.
strings.О действии, которое входит именно в полн: An action specifically within your authority’s powers, as confirmed by the competence card.
strings.О чём нынешний вопрос?: What is the current issue about?
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Объяснить заявителю границы решения наше: Explain the limits of our authority’s decision without requiring the applicant to renounce earlier letters
strings.Ответ любого органа освобождает все оста: A response from any authority releases all others from considering issues within their remit.
strings.Ответы были, но у другого органа · прове: There were replies, but from another body · checking the basis
strings.Отказать в рассмотрении только потому, ч: Refuse consideration solely because the applicant contacted several organisations
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Переадресовать обратно вопрос, который о: Refer back an issue that falls within our established powers.
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение собственного во: Prepare consideration of our own issue using the materials
strings.Помощник: «Один найденный исходящий номе: Assistant: “One outgoing reference number found proves every condition for ending correspondence.”
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Прежние ответы других органов не подтвер: Earlier responses from other authorities do not establish the same-authority condition for ending our own correspondence under Part 5 of Article 11.
strings.Прекратить любую переписку: теперь наш и: End all correspondence: an outgoing reference from our authority has now been found.
strings.Прекращение работы без выяснения обстоят: Stopping work without clarifying the circumstances
strings.Приписать своему органу чужие ответы как: Claim another authority’s responses as our own grounds for ending correspondence
strings.Проверить авторов прежних ответов и исто: Check who issued the earlier responses and the history of appeals specifically to us
strings.Проверить, что окончательный ответ дейст: Check that the final response actually addresses the present subject
strings.Проверка новых доводов недостаточна: в д: Checking for new arguments is insufficient: this variant changes who issued the earlier responses. A first appeal to the competent authority cannot be closed based on other authorities’ history.
strings.Проверяются орган, вопрос, содержание пр: Check the authority, issue, earlier responses’ contents, repetition and new arguments, not just one detail.
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Процедура предоставления услуги вместо о: A service-delivery procedure instead of reviewing a submission
strings.Рассмотрение обращения по закону № 59-ФЗ: Review of a submission under Law No. 59-FZ
strings.Рассмотреть вопрос в пределах собственно: Consider the issue within our own remit, using earlier responses as materials rather than automatic grounds for termination.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сопоставить нынешний предмет с установле: Compare the current subject with our established remit
strings.Сопоставить предметы: собственный ответ: Compare the subjects: our response about a different problem does not prove repeated responses to the current issue.
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.У текущего органа не было неоднократной: The current authority has not had repeated correspondence.
strings.Удалить старый документ, чтобы не разбир: Delete the old document to avoid examining the differences.
strings.Участник вымышленной учебной ситуации: Participant in a fictional training situation
strings.Учебное продолжение. При подготовке прое: Training follow-up. While preparing the draft, an old response from our authority is found, but it addresses another problem mentioned in the neighbouring paragraph of the earlier letter.
strings.Учебные документы подтверждают ответы дв: The training documents confirm responses from two other authorities. This is the applicant’s first appeal to the current competent authority. The issue falls within its remit, so there is no duty to refer it elsewhere again.
strings.Учебный материал; ссылка ведёт к правово: Training material; the link leads to the legal basis
strings.Часть 5 статьи 11 связывает данное основ: Article 11, part 5 ties this ground to appeals to the same body or official. The current body receives its first appeal on this subject; other bodies' letters do not replace that condition.
